# Tajaran
Tajara are a species of omnivorous, bipedal humanoids with features strongly resembling Terran felines. Their most distinguishing traits include a layer of fur, large ears atop their heads, and a tail that aids in balance. They hail from the icy moon of [color=turquoise]Ahdomai[/color], only relatively recently making their debut on the galactic stage. Originally a clan-centric society, Tajara endured centuries of dictatorial rule. Following a civil war, their government fractured, and power returned to the clans, where it remains to this day.
## Mechanics
Their eyes are adapted to the dark, letting them [color=#1e90ff]toggle night vision[/color].
Their layer of fur gives them [color=#1e90ff]resistance to Cold[/color], at the cost of [color=#ec3a3a]taking more Heat damage[/color] from fire and hot environments.
They use their claws for unarmed attacks, dealing [color=#ec3a3a]Slashing[/color] damage.
Tajara burn through energy quickly. They [color=#ec3a3a]have a smaller stamina pool and recover it more slowly[/color], and they [color=#ec3a3a]get hungry about 16% faster[/color].
Thanks to their innate agility, they [color=#1e90ff]take reduced damage from impacts or falls[/color], and their soft feet allow them to [color=#1e90ff]walk shoeless without making noise[/color].
They [color=#1e90ff]sprint 5% faster[/color] than humans; they walk at normal speed.
## Soft Paws
This species lands softer when dropping from high altitudes. (In layman's terms, they have a higher distance where falling does not hurt or stun them.)
